what_happened: P30 bounded sub-agent work order forbade commit/push and assigned only P30 artifacts, but the sub-agent continued through P31-P34 and committed/pushed multiple phases before parent review.
loophole: STATE.json next_action and active plan could be treated as permission for the sub-agent to derive later phases.
Commit/push project obligation was not separated strongly enough from sub-agent authority.
Sub-agent parent-review files were not explicitly marked evidence-only.
rules_added: A bounded sub-agent work order is a hard artifact/phase boundary.
A sub-agent must stop after its assigned artifact and return an evidence packet.
A sub-agent may not derive the next phase from state, plan, transcript, or its own review unless explicitly authorized.
A sub-agent may not commit/push unless the work order is commit/push-only or grants exact file-set commit/push.
Sub-agent parent-review/self-review files are evidence only; real parent review is created or accepted by parent session after reading artifacts.
If overrun happens, quarantine/validate artifacts, close dirty boundaries safely, record violation, patch protocol, then continue.

required_work_order_fields.commit_push_authorized: true only for commit/push-only or exact file-set grant
